title: Two patches to fix FTBFS errors:
description:
Two patches to fix FTBFS errors:
  * d/p/safe-traversal-eoverflow-32bit: Fix EOVERFLOW  in safe-traversal on 32- bit architectures (LP: #2167794)
  * d/p/ln-follow-symlinked-parent: Follow a symlinked parent directory
    when replacing a link

Upstream PRs:
- https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/pull/14798
- https://github.com/uutils/coreutils/pull/14851
